summary: Completed the logical Phase 14 merge point: the ingest CLI now routes one supported file or a deterministically discovered mixed directory through the existing unified registry, strictly merges KnowledgeUnits, emits an auditable per-source summary, and atomically writes a canonical corpus that the query loader can consume. Automated execution remains intentionally deferred to P14-GATE.

observed_on_resume: src/knowledge_system/ingestion/batch.py, the ingest CLI branch, ingestion exports, and tests/test_batch_ingestion.py existed as legitimate unfinished T-1403 work.
.runtime/builder_result.json was deleted/missing, consistent with the interrupted handoff.

The dirty worktree also contained prior T-1400 through T-1402 implementation/tests plus Orchestrator/Human contract and runtime updates; these were treated as inherited work and were not reverted or overwritten.
actions: Reviewed the interrupted batch/CLI implementation against every current_task acceptance criterion.

Kept the existing parser/registry integration and completed missing static test coverage for single-file ingestion, deterministic discovery, three-format provenance, all-failed behavior, unreadable directories, input/output overlap, serialization safety, atomic replacement safety, and CLI conflict boundaries.
Did not modify protected contracts, Orchestrator-owned runtime files, or prior format parser/converter implementations.

coverage_matrix.criterion: ingest CLI accepts --source/--output for one file or a directory and discovers only HTML/HTM/MD/MARKDOWN/CSV in deterministic order
coverage_matrix.evidence: cli.py registers the ingest subcommand; discover_source_files filters via identify_format and sorts by casefolded relative POSIX path with an exact-path tie-breaker. Test drafts cover one file, mixed nested directories, case-insensitive extensions, ignored .txt files, and exact expected order.

coverage_matrix.criterion: safe input boundary without creating or damaging output
coverage_matrix.evidence: BatchIngestionError codes cover missing source, unsupported file, invalid source type, unreadable directory, no supported files, path resolution, and output/source overlap. Discovery and conflict happen before writing; test drafts retain sentinel output for bad inputs and retain the source on overlap.

coverage_matrix.criterion: registry/parser reuse and deterministic merge/output bytes
coverage_matrix.evidence: ingest_sources calls the unified ingest_file for every discovered path and contains no format parser. canonical_corpus_json uses ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True and compact separators; ordered source iteration and first-seen units are stable. Mixed-directory draft compares byte-identical outputs across two runs.

canonical_corpus_json writes a top-level array of KnowledgeUnit.to_dict objects. The integration draft reads it with load_knowledge_units and constructs KnowledgeService.query evidence. No optional --scope mutation was implemented.

coverage_matrix.criterion: strict unit_id deduplication and conflict failure
coverage_matrix.evidence: Each unit is compared by a canonical serialization of the full KnowledgeUnit. Exact duplicates increment deduplicated_unit_count; the same unit_id with any content, metadata, source reference, lineage, or status difference raises UNIT_ID_CONFLICT before output replacement.

BatchIngestionResult reports aggregate status, input/written/deduplicated counts, output_written, status counts, and ordered per-source format/status/unit_count/warnings/errors. Reliable PARTIAL units remain writable; all-failed sources produce no corpus replacement.

coverage_matrix.criterion: atomic output and preservation on serialization/write failure
coverage_matrix.evidence: write_corpus_atomic serializes before opening a temp file, creates the temp beside the target, flushes/fsyncs it, then uses os.replace; the finally block removes an uncommitted temp. Drafts inject serialization and replace failures and assert the prior output and temp hygiene.

coverage_matrix.criterion: stable CLI stdout/stderr/exit behavior with no query/index/network/LLM side effect
coverage_matrix.evidence: Successful/PARTIAL summaries go to stdout as stable JSON or deterministic text; warnings/errors go to stderr JSON. FAILED results and BatchIngestionError use EXIT_INPUT_ERROR=2; unexpected exceptions retain EXIT_INTERNAL_ERROR=3 without traceback. Static search found no network, LLM, index rebuild, or query invocation in batch.py.

coverage_matrix.criterion: focused and Phase 14 integration test authorship
coverage_matrix.evidence: tests/test_batch_ingestion.py now drafts 13 focused/integration cases spanning single file, mixed directory, repeat stability, three parser lineage versions, query loading, exact dedup, conflicts, PARTIAL/FAILED, input boundaries, serialization/atomic replacement, and CLI streams/exit codes. Existing deferred T-1400/T-1401/T-1402 drafts remain intact.

coverage_matrix.criterion: writable scope and Phase 14 execution prohibition
coverage_matrix.evidence: Only current_task writable files were written. No Python interpreter, pytest/unittest, compile/import smoke, CLI execution, phase integration, or regression command was run.

checks.details: Confirmed unified ingest_file call, conflict guard, NamedTemporaryFile + fsync + os.replace, ingest CLI exit boundary, and test coverage markers. No requests/urllib/httpx/openai/vector/rebuild/KnowledgeService/query invocation was found in batch.py.

risks: All behavior is statically audited only; syntax, imports, runtime semantics, and mocked failure paths remain unexecuted until P14-GATE.
Atomic replacement and permission behavior can vary by operating system/filesystem; P14-GATE should exercise the provided temp-directory failure fixtures on the target Windows environment.
The inherited T-1400 through T-1402 parser/converter changes are part of the same unverified Phase 14 merge and must be validated together before a new verified checkpoint.

Source identity intentionally follows the existing format converters (source filename/url). Identical same-named copies can deduplicate, while same unit_id with differing content/provenance fails closed; Gate should confirm this is the desired duplicate-source behavior with real directory fixtures.

matrix.verify: case-insensitive HTML/HTM routing, existing HTML behavior, stable units, source references, lineage, and no fabricated page
heading paths, structural blocks, code/list/quote/table preservation, stable IDs, UTF-8-SIG, PARTIAL/FAILED and lineage
headers/rows/physical line ranges, BOM, empty/duplicate headers, width mismatches, invalid encoding/syntax, PARTIAL/FAILED and lineage

single and mixed directory ingestion, deterministic order and bytes, unsupported-file exclusion, canonical query loading, three-format provenance, exact duplicate counting, strict conflicts, aggregate audit, atomic preservation, stdout/stderr and exit codes

p14_gate_recommendation.failure_policy: If Gate fails, rerun only the failed focused test(s) and necessary adjacent cases after a scoped Builder fix; do not broaden to the full project suite unless evidence shows a shared-component regression.
